title: Shadow hVNC Malware Kit Gives Hackers Hidden Windows Desktop for Covert Remote Control
content_md: A newly advertised malware-as-a-service toolkit named Shadow hVNC combines browser credential theft, hidden virtual desktop control, reverse proxying, and extensive persistence into a single Windows-focused payload.
